column1: # Jordan / Gibson computer name search (scene 0x0FE): the dictionary the typed name is matched
# against, and the keyboard keys it is grouped under. English names are stored in the game's own
# full-width Latin (SJIS $82xx), one character per cell, so what the player types and what is
# stored are the same bytes -- the videophone's digits work exactly this way.
# Long forms are kept as the original does (KATRINAGIBSON as well as KATRINA); the short form is
# what fits the input field, which holds ten characters (counted in the emulator). A name must begin with a letter on its group's key: see tools/namesearch.py.
ジヤンジヤツクギブスン
